reconcile.note: Adam Clarke reads Revelation's altered tribe list as deliberate: Levi appears despite lacking territory while Dan and Ephraim drop out for promoting idolatry.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells tabulates all six tribal lists in the Skeptic's Annotated Bible and notes fourteen different names appear though only eight show up on every list.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: Of the children of Joseph: Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud. Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
sides.verseText: Of the children of Joseph: Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud. Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

sides.snippet: Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.
sides.verseText: These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you are passed over the Jordan: Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.
